title: Introduce commitment-safety-reservoir and rate-fence controller for safer burst contracts
author: Leah Donovan
release_notes: Adds a safety reservoir to prevent over-commitment of reserved capacity; introduces a rate-fence controller to enforce contractual burst limits; backwards-compatible config knobs for tenants.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers on Dedicated have asked for stronger guarantees when mixing long-running commitments and transient burst contracts. Under heavy multi-tenant pressure we observed rare cases where optimistic burst accounting allowed bursts to exhaust warm pools and caused SLA blips. This PR introduces two coordinated components: 1) CommitmentSafetyReservoir, a soft reservoir that holds a configurable fraction of a tenant's reservation to protect long-running commitments from transient burst consumption; 2) RateFenceController, a control loop that continuously reconciles burst usage against configurable per-tenant rate fences and signals the autoscaler to throttle or shed burst allocations before the reservoir is depleted.

Design highlights: - CommitmentSafetyReservoir operates per-tenant, is quota-aware, and decays toward reservation baseline with a tunable half-life. It is consulted by the WarmPoolAllocator and the BurstBank to decide whether an incoming burst can draw on reserved capacity. - RateFenceController exposes an API for policy (max_burst_tokens_per_minute, sustained_window_seconds, emergency_threshold_pct) and emits telemetry for reservoir level, headroom, and fence hits. It integrates with the existing TenantThrottleManager through a lightweight admission webhook. - Failure modes: when the controller becomes unavailable, the system conservatively reduces burst grants by the configured fail_closed_ratio. This ensures reservations are not jeopardized during controller outages.

Sana Patel (reviewer): Nit: clarify units for max_burst_tokens_per_minute in the API doc. Also suggest exposing reservoir_level as both absolute and percentage for dashboards.
Leah Donovan (author): Updated API doc and telemetry to emit reservoir_level_bytes and reservoir_level_pct. Dashboard JSON updated.
Evan Brooks (approver): Verified canary run on dedicated-staging with mixed tenants; no regression on long-running commitments. Approving.
